Q: What is the primary purpose of a ticketing system?
Option1: Track issues from intake to resolution

Q: Which item belongs in the User Information section of a ticket?
Option1: Contact details and department

Q: Which ticket field is used to group similar problems for triage and routing?
Option1: Category

Q: What does Severity in a ticket usually describe?
Option1: Business impact and urgency
Option3: The number of users in the company

Q: Why are escalation levels defined in a ticketing process?
Option1: To ensure issues move to the right expertise when needed

Q: Which statement reflects clear, concise written communication in tickets?
Option1: Use objective facts and steps to reproduce

Q: What are Progress Notes primarily used for?
Option1: Time ordered updates and actions taken

Q: What should a Problem Resolution entry include?
Option1: Fix applied and verification of success

Q: Which best describes an Inventory List in asset management?
Option1: A catalog of hardware and software with key attributes
Option4: A set of printer default settings

Q: What is the role of Asset Tags and IDs?
Option1: Provide unique identifiers that tie devices to records

Q: Why track the Procurement Life Cycle?
Option1: Plan from request to disposal for cost and compliance

Q: Warranty and Licensing records are critical because they help to:
Option1: Prove support eligibility and license compliance

Q: Mapping Assigned Users to devices primarily supports:
Option1: Ownership

Q: Why use a centralized Asset Database System?
Option1: Single source of truth with query and reporting

Q: What does an Acceptable Use Policy define?
Option1: Allowed and prohibited behavior on company systems

Q: What is the purpose of a Network Topology Diagram?
Option1: Show device interconnections and paths

Q: Regulatory Compliance Requirements documentation helps teams:
Option1: Meet legal obligations and pass audits

Q: What is a Splash Screen in this context?
Option1: Login or startup banner that can present notices or AUP
Option2: Full disk image used for deployment

Q: What should an Incident Report capture?
Option1: Timeline

Q: What is a Standard Operating Procedure used for?
Option1: Repeatable step by step tasks with roles and checks

Q: Why document a Custom Software Installation Procedure?
Option1: Ensure consistent installs and supportability

Q: What typically appears on a New User Setup Checklist?
Option1: Account creation

Q: What typically appears on a Termination Checklist?
Option1: Disable accounts

Q: What is the main benefit of a Knowledge Base?
Option1: Reusable solutions that reduce time to resolve

Q: A ticket is network related and marked Critical. What is the best immediate action?
Option1: Assign to network queue and follow escalation matrix

Q: Which documentation pair best supports rapid incident response together?
Option1: Topology diagrams and asset inventory
Option2: Printer catalogs and wall paint codes
Option4: Holiday schedule and org chart colors
